{{Otheruses|Banks}}
[[File:NabooBank.jpg|130px|thumb|A Nabooian banking kiosk]]
A '''bank''' was an institution that retains money, commodities, private equity and financial documentation and assets as well as creating credit and authorizing lending. There were many banks in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
